evaluation_scope: Retrospective count-based province/city ranking, not population risk, not a next-week case forecast. Held-out years train on strictly earlier years; missing units are excluded, never zero-filled.
population_status: Unit-aligned PSA denominators unverified. Count rankings are confounded by population size; no per-100,000 or individual-risk claim.
boundary_scope: Exact crosswalk name matches do not establish administrative/reporting catchment equivalence. Independently reported cities may have unmatched polygons.
weather_reason: Lagged weather did not consistently beat both seasonal-only baselines across held-out years and all three metrics.

metric_definitions.spearman: Mean per-week Spearman correlation; tied average ranks.
metric_definitions.top10_hit_rate: Intersection of actual/predicted top ten divided by ten; alphabetical unit order resolves boundary ties.
metric_definitions.normalized_rank_error: Mean absolute rank difference divided by number of units minus one; lower is better.

hyperparameters: Fixed ridge penalty 10; log1p counts/features; training-only standardization. Seasonal mean uses circular 53-slot ISO week-of-year +/-2, training years only. Weather is observed ERA5 mean temperature and total precipitation at source polygon geometric centroid, lagged 14-27 days before target source-date label (availability buffer). No future weather or case target enters features.
